locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; ordinary conclusion addressed to the Father, including Amen

entries.claim: This separate rule supplies w019–w040: the ordinary 21-word conclusion and Amen. Each composite combines only loci of this same edition. Amen’s enumeration semicolon is literal; the selected separate response uses a period. This rule alone establishes no response actor or requirement to repeat each conclusion in an assembled commemoration group.
